voice.name: Open Sector - Pyro
voice.description: Unhinged, gleeful male flamethrower trooper of indeterminate age, nasal high-pitched voice with a manic giggle, sing-song delivery, talks about fire like a lover, slightly muffled as if through a heat mask, unpredictable shifts from whispering to cackling, clearly enjoys his job far too much.
voice.sample: Pyro! Ooh, is it my turn? Everything's so cold and green out there. Let's fix that, hm? Just a little warmth, a little crackle. Hee hee. Everybody loves a campfire, don't they?

fire.prompt: Flamethrower burst, roaring whoosh of ignited fuel jet spraying fire, crackling flames and hissing pressure, outdoors, close range, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt with heavy fuel tanks on his back, liquid sloshing, metal hoses clinking, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Flamethrower fuel tanks rupturing and exploding, sharp burst then whooshing fireball and crackling flames, outdoors, close range, no music, no voice
